slides.headline: OPENAI'S OWN RESEARCHERS WARN AI IS MOVING PAST HUMAN CONTROL
slides.body: Researchers inside OpenAI have warned that AI is now advancing faster than humans can understand or manage it. That concern didn't come from outside critics, it came from inside the lab that built ChatGPT

slides.headline: SOMEONE JUST BUILT THEIR ENTIRE WEDDING WEBSITE WITH GPT-6
slides.body: A user ran GPT-6, OpenAI's newest model, start to finish to build a complete wedding website, no developer involved. What used to take a professional days took one conversation with an AI

slides.headline: OPENAI'S OPERATOR JUST HANDLED 1 MILLION AUTONOMOUS TASKS IN 24 HOURS
slides.body: OpenAI's Operator, which browses, books, and buys on your behalf, hit that milestone this week without a single human click. The tool only left closed beta six months ago; now it is replacing whole categories of computer work

slides.headline: THE AI THAT'S NOW OUTDIAGNOSING RADIOLOGISTS IN REAL HOSPITALS
slides.body: Google DeepMind's medical AI went live in major hospital systems this week, flagging cancer and organ disease faster and more accurately than specialist radiologists in controlled trials. Regulators are now reviewing the results for full clinical approval

slides.headline: WHILE YOU SCROLLED, SOMEONE BUILT A 3D ROCKET SITE IN BLENDER
slides.body: One builder used Grok Build to design a full rocket launch site in Blender from scratch, Grok handled the hard parts automatically, no manual modeling. Hours of work collapsed into a single fast session, and the builder said the speed and quality were beyond what he expected

slides.headline: SAVE TODAY'S AI BRIEFING
slides.body:

• GPT-6 built a complete wedding website, start to finish
• OpenAI Operator logged 1 million autonomous tasks in 24 hours
• DeepMind's medical AI went live in hospitals, outperforming radiologists
• Grok Build created a full 3D rocket launch site in Blender, by itself
